description: Commerce workspace additions: catalogue products, historical line-item snapshots, quotes, subscriptions, invoices, payments, orders, commercial party links, and rollup totals.

object_types.description: Catalogue product data that may change over time; historical revenue uses line item snapshots instead.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: Current catalogue product name.

attributes.name: SKU
attributes.description: Current catalogue stock-keeping unit or product code.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Current catalogue description; line item descriptions are historical snapshots.

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: Current catalogue availability state.

attributes.name: Category
attributes.description: Catalogue grouping used for filtering and reporting.

attributes.name: Current unit price
attributes.description: Current catalogue list price; does not rewrite existing line item snapshots.

attributes.name: Current unit cost
attributes.description: Current internal unit cost; does not rewrite existing line item snapshots.

attributes.name: Billing frequency
attributes.description: Default billing cadence for new commercial line items.

attributes.name: External reference
attributes.description: Structural upstream product identifier for idempotent sync.

derived_attributes.name: Line item count
derived_attributes.description: Count of active line item snapshots linked to this product.

derived_attributes.name: Line item revenue total
derived_attributes.description: Sum of active linked line item total amounts when all contributing line items share one currency; mixed currencies materialize null.

object_types.description: Historical commercial snapshot for a product on a deal, quote, order, invoice, or subscription parent.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: Line item display name copied at the commercial moment.

attributes.name: SKU
attributes.description: Product SKU copied into this historical line item snapshot.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Commercial description copied into this line item snapshot.

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: Snapshot quantity for this commercial line item.

attributes.name: Unit price
attributes.description: Snapshot unit price; later product price changes do not alter it.

attributes.name: Unit cost
attributes.description: Snapshot internal unit cost.

attributes.name: Discount percent
attributes.description: Snapshot percentage discount from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: Discount amount
attributes.description: Snapshot absolute discount amount in the line item currency.

attributes.name: Tax percent
attributes.description: Snapshot tax percentage from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: Tax amount
attributes.description: Snapshot tax amount in the line item currency.

attributes.name: Total amount
attributes.description: Snapshot total amount after quantity, discount and tax; DeepCRM stores the submitted commercial fact and does not infer arithmetic.

attributes.name: Billing frequency
attributes.description: Snapshot billing cadence for this line item.

attributes.name: Billing start date
attributes.description: Snapshot billing start date.

attributes.name: Billing terms
attributes.description: Snapshot billing terms or term label.

attributes.name: Snapshot at
attributes.description: When the line item commercial snapshot was captured.

attributes.name: Product
attributes.description: Catalogue product this snapshot came from; omitted or unlinked snapshots still retain their copied fields.

attributes.name: Deal
attributes.description: Deal this line item belongs to as a commercial parent when the snapshot is deal-scoped.

attributes.name: Quote
attributes.description: Quote this copied line item belongs to.

attributes.name: Order
attributes.description: Order this copied line item belongs to.

attributes.name: Invoice
attributes.description: Invoice this copied line item belongs to.

attributes.name: Subscription
attributes.description: Subscription this copied recurring line item belongs to.

attributes.name: External reference
attributes.description: Structural upstream line-item identifier for idempotent sync.

derived_attributes.name: Line item count
derived_attributes.description: Count of active line item snapshots linked to this deal.

derived_attributes.name: Line item total
derived_attributes.description: Sum of active linked line item totals when all contributing line items share one currency; mixed currencies materialize null.
